observer: DwgLTypeControlByBlockAc1018Candidate::inspect walks two untrusted frames, confirms common headers, BL count 1, control H4 null owner and ordered H2 ordinary / H3 ByBlock / H3 ByLayer references, and cross-checks the ByBlock target and row H4 owner. The row must have source-observed ByBlock name, flags, empty description, zero pattern length, alignment 65, zero dashes, all 256 string-area bytes zero and an H5 null xref. Selected typed fields including normalized/raw xref role are compared; opaque callback metadata does not become authority. The null H4 acceptance is restricted to this control profile. It preserves both sibling references as values and spans, without asserting the target records exist or assigning DXF ownership semantics to H roles. A separate inspectNormativeOrder entry point applies the ODA ByLayer-then-ByBlock order without changing the source-profile inspector.
